positions.name: OwnedVsRentedIntelligence
positions.frame: Where does the owned part of intelligence sit when the substrate can be rented, and what does ownership of a perspective mean as distinct from ownership of the underlying model?
positions.why: The two parallel maxims (src-3, src-4) read in one direction: owned intelligence is opposed to rented intelligence, and the substrate is a commodity while the perspective is the asset kept. src-5 states that the segment restates the individually-owned-intelligence thesis, so it reads in the same direction as the maxims. The set is a single contrast framed as a thesis; it is stated, not argued, and no tension is held within it.
